semantic_regions.exposure_comment: The 'Rock Formation' appears washed out with reduced color saturation. Detail in the bright vertical rock faces is compromised due to the excess brightness.
semantic_regions.local_adjustment_suggestion: Decrease highlights and overall exposure for the 'Rock Formation' to recover the deep red tones and texture of the sandstone.

global_saliency_analysis.primary_distortion_reason: The 'Rock Formation' is the central subject of the composition, yet its impact is diminished by the overexposure which flattens its dimensionality and washes out its color.

global_exposure_strategy.global_exposure_suggestion: The entire image is significantly high-key. A global reduction in exposure is necessary to bring the scene back to a natural dynamic range.
global_exposure_strategy.regional_balance_strategy: Significantly lower the global exposure, then fine-tune the 'Rock Formation' specifically to ensure its shadows don't become blocked up as the overall brightness is reduced.
